why_best: This presentation instantly telegraphs deep technical expertise and classic utility, building trust with a developer audience through familiar visual shorthand.
why_bad: Swapping this for a polished modern interface or abstract visual card strips away the gritty authenticity and focus required for a true developer beat.
trap: Failing to pace the text reveal naturally will destroy the illusion of a live human session and turn an engaging moment into a static wall of text.
